description: A painted interior: four women in black abayas and headscarves, one seated in front and three standing behind and beside her, with a young girl in black at the right. They face right toward a boxy CRT television on a dark wooden stand, whose screen shows a blurred group of figures in a formal hall. A dim lamp glows in the background, with patterned rugs on the floor. No visible text, frame or violence.
